title: Austin's Voting Officials and Auditorium Project
summary:
*   **Election Preparedness:** Austin leaders appointed election officials for 37 precincts, including alternates, to oversee the upcoming April 2nd General Election.
*   **Auditorium Project Review:** Discussions took place regarding a payment for the preliminary architectural plans of a proposed new Auditorium.
*   **Payment Decision Postponed:** No immediate decision was reached on the Auditorium payment, with architects requested to provide a detailed list of their completed work.

The meeting was called to order with Mayor McAden presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Long, Pearson, Thompson, White, Mayor McAden Absent: None The Mayor announced
that this meeting was called for the purpose of appointing election officials for the
General Election to be held on April 2, 1955; and for the purpose of discussing the
payment of one-eighth of the fee for the preliminary plans of the Auditorium.
The Council appointed the election officials for the 37 precincts and appointed alternates
in some precincts. The City Attorney was instructed to prepare an ordinance for the
appointment of these officials.
The Council discussed the payment of one-eighth of the fee to the Architects for the
preliminary plans of the Auditorium. No action was taken by the Council at this time, but
it was suggested that the Architects submit a list of the work done.
There being no further business the Council adjourned subject to the call of the Mayor.
